tg.conclusion: Reviewed Telegram 0.83.0: 0.78.0-0.83.0 dropped messages list --mark-read and the catch_up_marks_read setting (mark a chat read only with chats mark-read), added chats mute, unmute, archive, unarchive, pin, unpin, mark-unread, start and app, messages press (bot buttons), contacts prepare, the attachments group (download, check, move, daily jobs), search --offline and transcript search, tg compare against five tools, and profile-first command examples. Changed native pages: changelog, commands, archive, attachments, compare, configuration, configuration-reference, mcp, people, query-language, recipes, roadmap, search, usage and the v0.83.0 release link in cli-contract; RU/ES updated. Roadmap reviewed: muting a chat, bot buttons and starting a bot left the max parity list; the archive-pin-mute item and the file copy check are new; several photos in one message, a reply saved as draft and chat notes are not shipped.

max.conclusion: Reviewed MAX 0.66.0 (Core 0.370.0): max guide catch-up and the first screen of max --help quote the filter, max review 'date>1d' --unanswered 4h (unquoted, a shell wrote a file named 1d and dropped the filter; the site's correction for it is retired); Works with shows memo's title from cli-core MEMO_SCENARIOS. Core 0.363.0-0.370.0: store version 25 keeps a chat's history; a left chat is found by any id, chats track and store gaps plan refuse it. Changed native pages: changelog, scenarios (quoted step), and the v0.66.0 release links in bot/cli-contract/usage; EN/ES (RU scenarios) updated. Roadmap unchanged: optional local copy, event actions, video notes, cloud password and native installers are not shipped.

zm.conclusion: Reviewed Zoom 0.32.0-0.36.0 (Core 0.370.0 -> 0.389.0): the profile is the first word (zm personal meetings list; ZM_PROFILE for a shell; each profile has its own Zoom login); zm <profile> mcp replaces zm serve --mcp and offers zm's commands as the profile's permissions allow; permissions per profile; stats meetings; models audio; meetings transcribe takes Zoom's recordings; .txt transcript import; search reads the query language and ranks words and meaning together; meeting writes ask first. Changed native pages: every guide (profile prefix), changelog, commands, configuration (Permissions), mcp (rewritten), search, sessions; RU/ES updated. Portal copies (install prompts, agents, MCP, Zoom overview, command rules) moved to zm personal. Roadmap unchanged: broader meeting preparation remains planned and is not shipped.

drive.conclusion: Reviewed Drive 0.25.0: the first roadmap page and a compare page ship with this tag; drive doctor and drive upgrade are new commands; the profile is the first word or DRIVE_PROFILE and there is no --profile option. Changed native pages: changelog, commands, compare, configuration, installation, roadmap, troubleshooting; RU/ES written. The roadmap is new, so every item on it is unshipped.

memo.conclusion: Reviewed Memo 0.91.0: command-derived MCP coverage with 37 preserved legacy tool names, saved permissions and stricter-only server overrides, opening cited notes/messages, explicit delegated meeting/annotation decisions, local model download, explicit Himalaya account add/check and all shared meeting selectors. Source versions match tg: core 0.404.0, base 0.50.3. Reviewed EN sources and RU/ES updates for commands, configuration, how-it-works, index, installation, mail, MCP, memories, notes, recipes, roadmap, search, security, troubleshooting and changelog; added the comparison page in RU/ES. Portal corrections clarify explicit meeting delegation and remote versus local model use. Roadmap removes shipped model download, account setup and cited-item reads; HTTP, visual UI, full graph export and engine benchmark results remain unshipped. Individual MCP tools remain a known standards gap (MEMO-31); this review does not certify full standards compliance.
